title: Framer agent cards
description: A section head over a column of tall hairline cards, each a big dark media well with a title, grey copy and an arrow link under it, beside a narrow side panel that stays pinned while the cards scroll past; a wider closing card sits next to a second panel. Each card brightens from 20% and slides in 20px from the left as it scrolls into view.
notes: media wells and both side panels are slots (`media`, `aside`, `closing.panel`); empty, they show placeholders of the original's size
side panels are desktop-only; on phones the closing card stacks as a normal card
the reveal is a CSS scroll-driven animation; browsers without it, and reduced motion, show the cards as they are
